pages.title: Armor Durability HUD
pages.text: Displays an icon for each equipped armor piece, showing its durability just like your inventory. Icons always sit next to each other with no gaps.

pages.title: Opening the HUD Menu
pages.text: Use the command /hudmenu to open the configuration menu (requires operator level 2). From there you can show or hide the HUD, or enter the interactive editor: drag with your mouse to move it, scroll to switch orientation, use +/- to resize, and press Enter to save.
